result.instructions: Tools for Mixmax, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which sequences do I have, and which of them are in a folder?"; "Show my last 10 messages and whether each one was sent."; "Find the template named 'Demo follow-up' and show its body.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Mixmax data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run mixmax_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run mixmax_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run mixmax_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. mixmax_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: mixmax_get_me
tools.title: Get the token's user id
tools.description: Return the Mixmax user id that the API token belongs to. Use it to check that the connection works. Mixmax API: GET /v1/users/me.

tools.name: mixmax_list_messages
tools.title: List messages
tools.description: List your messages (emails): drafts, scheduled, sent and failed. Newest first. Sent messages have no body. Mixmax API: GET /v1/messages.

limit.description: Messages per page. Values above 300 return 300.

next.description: The next cursor from the previous page. Use it only when hasNext is true.

fields.description: Comma-separated message fields to return, for example subject,created.

tools.name: mixmax_get_message
tools.title: Get a message
tools.description: Get one message (email) by id: recipients, subject, tracking settings and send state. Mixmax API: GET /v1/messages/{id}.

tools.name: mixmax_create_draft
tools.title: Create a draft email
tools.description: Create a draft email in Mixmax. It does NOT send the email: nothing reaches a recipient until someone sends or schedules the draft in Mixmax. Mixmax API: POST /v1/messages.

tools.name: mixmax_list_sequences
tools.title: List sequences
tools.description: List the sequences you can access: your own, those shared with you, and (for admins) the workspace's. Mixmax API: GET /v1/sequences.

name.description: Only sequences whose name matches this text.

folder.description: personal, shared, all, or a sequence folder id.

expand.description: stages adds each stage's content; folder adds the folder.

next.description: The next cursor from the previous page. Use it only when hasNext is true.

tools.name: mixmax_list_sequence_recipients
tools.title: List sequence recipients
tools.description: List the recipients of one sequence, with per-stage activity (opens, clicks, replies). Mixmax API: GET /v1/sequences/{id}/recipients/.

offset.description: Recipients to skip. offset plus limit is at most 25000.

query.description: Narrow the list, for example a full email address.

tools.name: mixmax_list_sequence_folders
tools.title: List sequence folders
tools.description: List the sequence folders you can access. Mixmax API: GET /v1/sequencefolders.

tools.name: mixmax_get_sequence_folder
tools.title: Get a sequence folder
tools.description: Get one sequence folder you can access, with the ids of its sequences. Mixmax API: GET /v1/sequencefolders/{id}.

tools.name: mixmax_list_templates
tools.title: List templates
tools.description: List the email templates you can access (your own, shared with you, or in your workspace). Mixmax API: GET /v1/snippets.

search.description: Text to filter templates by (Mixmax search syntax).

isInline.description: false for templates only; true for snippets only.

sort.description: name (default), createdAt, savedAt, or an analytics field such as analytics.sent.

next.description: The next cursor from the previous page. Use it only when hasNext is true.

tools.name: mixmax_get_template
tools.title: Get a template
tools.description: Get one template by id, with its subject and body. Mixmax API: GET /v1/snippets/{id}.

tools.name: mixmax_list_template_folders
tools.title: List template folders
tools.description: List the template folders you can access. Mixmax API: GET /v1/snippettags.

search.description: Folders with a word in the name that starts with this text.

isInline.description: false for template folders only; true for snippet folders only.

expand.description: count adds the number of templates per folder.

next.description: The next cursor from the previous page. Use it only when hasNext is true.

tools.name: mixmax_list_unsubscribes
tools.title: List unsubscribed addresses
tools.description: List the addresses on your unsubscribe list (your workspace's list if you belong to one). Sequences do not send to them. Mixmax API: GET /v1/unsubscribes.

email.description: Return only this address (exact match, case-insensitive).

sort.description: Field to sort by, for example createdAt or email.

sortAscending.description: true sorts ascending; default is newest first.

next.description: The next cursor from the previous page. Use it only when hasNext is true.

previous.description: The previous cursor from the previous page. Use it only when hasPrevious is true.

expand.description: sequence adds the sequence (id and name) for records from a sequence.

tools.name: mixmax_add_unsubscribes
tools.title: Add unsubscribed addresses
tools.description: Add addresses to your unsubscribe list. Sequences then stop sending to them. Use it only when the address owner asked to stop getting email. Mixmax API: POST /v1/unsubscribes.

tools.name: mixmax_list_meeting_invites
tools.title: List meeting invites
tools.description: List the meeting invites you sent: emails where you offered times to meet. Booked meetings appear with their time. Mixmax API: GET /v1/meetinginvites.

next.description: The next cursor from the previous page. Use it only when hasNext is true.

previous.description: The previous cursor from the previous page. Use it only when hasPrevious is true.

tools.name: mixmax_list_teams
tools.title: List teams
tools.description: List the teams you are an accepted member of. Mixmax API: GET /v1/teams.

expand.description: Comma-separated. members adds each team's members; members.userId adds their name and email.

accessThrough.description: myself lists only the teams you are a member of.

next.description: The next cursor from the previous page. Use it only when hasNext is true.

previous.description: The previous cursor from the previous page. Use it only when hasPrevious is true.

prompts.title: Get started with Mixmax
prompts.description: What you can do with Mixmax here, with example requests to try.
